description: Working solo on this project—team is closed
summary: Earth Tracker is an interactive data-exploration tool designed to make NASA's complex Earth science datasets accessible / findable to everyday students, farmers, and local planners. By separating long-term climate changes from seasonal weather swings, Earth Tracker is something that can help users quickly identify what is changing, by how much, what's important to look at, where it's changing and it's implications on society and themselves.
